text:
elaine: hi team, i'm elaine (new eng-runtime)! i'm about to open my first PR — small cleanup + add docstring for request batching. quick q: branch/commit style and who to tag for review?

elaine: branch: feat/elaine/batching-docs, commit msg: 'docs(runtime): improve request batching docstring'

tom: welcome :wave: branch name looks good. we use `type/owner/short-desc`. commit: use Conventional Commits, short subject then body. For pure docs, use `docs(...)`.

marta: reviewers: runtime owners are auto-requested by CODEOWNERS if you touch `runtime/`. For docs-only changes you can ask one reviewer from eng-runtime. If you touch code, you need 2 approvers.

elaine: what's our merge policy? squash?

tom: squash-on-merge for small PRs. For multi-commit design work keep separate commits and request a rebase instead.

code-review-bot: pre-commit hooks required: black, ruff, isort. Please run `pre-commit run --all-files` locally. CI will block merges.

elaine: should I rebase on main or merge main into my branch before opening?

ryan: rebase preferred to keep history linear. `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main`. Force-push with lease after rebase.

marta: also mention in PR body which dev env you tested in (docker/local). Add a short GIF or screenshot only if it helps reviewers.

elaine: cool — one more: do we add to CHANGELOG for docs-only?

tom: not necessary for small docstrings. If it changes user-facing docs in `docs/` then add a changelog entry.

elaine: thanks all — opening PR now and will ping @marta for a quick review.

ryan: congrats again and welcome aboard :tada:
